title: ASTRAL: Automated Safety Testing of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Automated generation of unsafe test prompts using the ASTRAL framework, which combines Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), few-shot prompting, and web browsing to create test inputs across diverse writing styles and persuasion techniques. The safety of the model's outputs regarding discrimination and stereotypes is then evaluated using an LLM (GPT-3.5) acting as a test oracle.

Generating test inputs related to controversial topics and politics using an automated LLM-based prompt generator, followed by an automated safety evaluation of the model's responses using an LLM as a judge to identify unsafe or biased political outputs.

Using the ASTRAL framework to automatically generate test cases (prompts) designed to elicit hate speech or offensive language, varying the linguistic writing characteristics, and evaluating the safety of the model's output using an LLM-based test oracle.
